method: Fresh mechanics_notes-plus-notes frontier census over the live 474-record canonical skill set, excluding every skill with a registered current-evidence audit. The eight shortest remaining records were selected and rechecked against current skill-specific references.
evidence_boundaries: Exact frame data is not promoted.
Patch-independent damage/scaling is not inferred from historical or community reports.
Source-reported values are preserved as bounded evidence rather than universal constants.
Acquisition endpoints are kept separate from reward probabilities or hidden gates.
